summary: End-to-end ML platforms bundle data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring into a unified managed environment, which matters most when you train or customize your own models, operate at scale, and need governance, reproducibility, and MLOps automation. If you only need to call a pretrained model (e.g., via an LLM API) a full platform is overkill — a simple API plus light orchestration suffices. You need a platform once you own the model lifecycle: custom training/fine-tuning, pipelines, A/B deployment, drift monitoring, and compliance.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per instance-hour for compute (training, notebooks, endpoints) plus storage; no upfront license.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams building, training, and deploying custom models at scale with deep AWS ecosystem integration.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute instance-hour plus storage; free tier for studio, enterprise agreements available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises on the Microsoft/Azure stack needing governance, responsible AI tooling, and integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per node/compute-hour, plus per-prediction and foundation model token pricing; no license fee.
platforms.best_for: Highly automated, state-of-the-art managed ML and access to Google foundation models (Gemini) for GCP users.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBU (Databricks Unit) pricing on top of underlying cloud compute; enterprise tiers.
platforms.best_for: Unified data + ML/AI on a lakehouse across multiple clouds, including large-scale LLM pretraining and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based subscription for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: Experiment tracking, reproducibility, and collaboration layered on top of any training framework or cloud.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Automated machine learning and governed MLOps for business analysts and enterprises seeking low-code workflows.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise (Driverless AI, H2O AI Cloud) via subscription/license.
platforms.best_for: Automated ML with strong explainability and open-source flexibility, deployable anywhere including on-prem.

platforms.name: Amazon Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per token (input/output) plus provisioned throughput options.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises building generative AI apps on managed foundation models without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: MLflow (open source)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed hosting costs vary by provider.
platforms.best_for: Open, framework-agnostic experiment tracking and model lifecycle management across any stack.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing (CPU/GPU); generous free tier credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers who want serverless, code-first GPU compute for training and deploying models without infra management.
